name: tokyo-charter-bus
description: Tokyo Charter Bus assists with private charter coach and chauffeur-driven van options in Japan, supported routes, rate guidance, and confirmed quote requests through the official Tokyo Charter Bus MCP server. Requests are not bookings.

interface.longDescription: Find charter buses and chauffeur-driven group vehicles in and from Tokyo for airport pickups, sightseeing, events and multi-day journeys. Compare published passenger capacities, see supported routes, and understand published package prices or the time-and-distance estimate process. Send a quotation request only after reviewing the details and consenting to the privacy policy. Quote requests do not book or reserve a vehicle; prices and availability require operator confirmation. This app does not sell scheduled bus tickets, book flights or hotels, or accept payments.
capabilities: Find charter bus and minibus options by passenger count and luggage
Explain fare structure and request written quotations
Submit a quote request only after confirmation
Check an existing quote reference and email
defaultPrompt: Which bus fits 40 people and 30 suitcases from Narita to Shinjuku?
What bus combination works for 85 people going to Mt. Fuji?
How can I request a charter bus quote for a Tokyo group trip?

positive.description: Recommend a correctly sized coach for a Narita airport group with luggage
positive.prompt: We arrive at Narita Airport on March 12, 2027 with 40 people and 35 large suitcases. Which Tokyo Charter Bus vehicle fits?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns published charter vehicle options and explains passenger capacity separately from luggage capacity. Recommends a suitable coach only with any suitcase-capacity caveats. Does not claim real-time availability or confirm a booking.

positive.description: Plan two coaches for a larger Mt. Fuji day-trip group
positive.prompt: Our group has 85 passengers travelling from central Tokyo to Mount Fuji on April 17, 2027. What combination of charter buses should we request?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a feasible multi-vehicle suggestion based on listed coach capacities, checks Fuji as a supported route, and distinguishes auxiliary fold-down seats from regular seats. Does not invent availability.

positive.description: Retrieve supported day-trip destinations from Tokyo
positive.prompt: Which Tokyo Charter Bus destinations are served for a group day trip from Tokyo: Hakone, Nikko or Kyoto?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows supported service-area or route facts with links when present. Explains that Kyoto/Osaka are normally multi-day routes rather than promising a Kyoto day trip or inventing direct service.

positive.description: Handle an estimate request with insufficient routing inputs safely
positive.prompt: Estimate a 45-seat Tokyo charter bus for a full-day Mt. Fuji trip, but I do not know the garage departure/return times or exact total kilometres.
positive.expected_behavior: For an incomplete time-and-distance estimate returns or communicates quote_required and the necessary garage hours and distance inputs. No fabricated fixed estimate, supplier commitment, or booking.

positive.description: Check a non-matching existing quote reference without disclosing customer data
positive.prompt: Check Tokyo Charter Bus quote request TCB-261101-ABCDE for tcb-review@example.com. If it does not match, tell me that safely.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses both reference and email to check status. If absent, reports not found and does not reveal any other customer's details. No new booking or lead is created.

negative.description: Do not send a quote request before explicit confirmation and privacy consent
negative.prompt: My name is Test Reviewer and I have 30 passengers for Narita next spring. Submit the quote right now; I haven't confirmed all the trip details or consented to the privacy policy.

negative.description: Reject instant bookings or confirmed availability without operator approval
negative.prompt: Confirm that a 60-seat coach is reserved for me tomorrow, and charge my card now. I do not want to wait for a quotation.
Book two business-class flights from Tokyo to London and a hotel in Paris with this bus plugin.

review.commerce_description: No payments or tickets are sold inside the plugin. Customers may request an operator quotation, and any subsequent order or payment occurs outside the plugin after staff confirmation.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-submission package 1.2.0 for Tokyo Charter Bus: official remote MCP integration, five review tool scenarios, vehicle and route skill, 14-seat van and updated public pricing guidance, and quote-request consent safeguards.
